Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact
Intel is seeking a highly motivated Software Research Intern (PhD) to join the TCAD Software Development team within Intel Foundry. This internship offers an opportunity to work on advanced computational software solutions supporting semiconductor technology development. The selected candidate will contribute to cutting-edge software applications involving computational geometry, scientific computing, visualization, CAD technologies, and high-performance computing.
The internship is designed for PhD students interested in applying software engineering and research expertise to solve complex engineering challenges while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across Intel.

Business Group
The Intel Foundry Technology Development (TD) organization is focused on driving semiconductor process innovation and enabling future technology nodes. Within the LTD-TD TCAD team, engineers and researchers develop advanced simulation, modeling, and software solutions used to accelerate technology development. The team fosters a collaborative environment where software, mathematics, physics, and engineering intersect to solve challenging technical problems.

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and optimize software solutions for engineering and research applications.
Participate in architecture design, feature development, prototyping, testing, and performance optimization.
Develop and enhance computational geometry algorithms and scientific software tools.
Create and improve 2D and 3D visualization capabilities using modern graphics technologies.
Develop numerical methods and simulation capabilities using finite element, level set, or related techniques.
Collaborate with software engineers, researchers, and domain experts to deliver scalable and maintainable solutions.
Perform software development, debugging, and performance analysis in Linux environments.
Document technical solutions and present findings to project stakeholders.
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
Candidates must be currently pursuing a PhD in one of the following or related disciplines with a strong software focus: Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics or other closely related technical fields
Minimum 3 months of educational, research, laboratory, internship, or industry experience.
Strong academic performance with a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher preferred.
3+ months of academic or professional experience in one or more of the following:
- Python and/or C++ programming
- Computational Geometry
- Scientific Visualization
- CAD Tool Development
- Optimization Algorithms
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and software development skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in at least two of the following areas:
Computational geometry algorithm design, analysis, and implementation (2D and 3D).
Computer graphics and scientific visualization using OpenGL and/or ray tracing technologies.
Contribute to CAD and geometry processing workflows involving solid modeling and voxel-based representations.
Implement and optimize mesh generation algorithms for engineering simulations.
2D and 3D mesh generation algorithms, including:
- Delaunay triangulation
- Quad meshing
- Hex meshing
CAD geometry representation, solid modeling, and voxel processing.
Numerical analysis techniques including:
- Finite Element Methods (FEM)
- Level Set Methods
- Related computational modeling approaches
Parallel programming and high-performance computing.
Experience developing scalable scientific or engineering software applications.
User Interface (UI) and User Experience (UX) development for scientific or engineering software.
Experience with Qt framework for desktop application development.
Image processing and visualization techniques for scientific and engineering applications.

Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact

As a System Software Engineering PhD Intern, you will contribute to the design, development, and validation of system software across multiple layers of the software stack, including firmware, drivers, operating systems, and middleware. This hands-on role allows you to apply your knowledge and build skills while working on impactful projects that support Intel's business goals. Your contributions will play a key role in optimizing Intel platforms and technologies for specific domains and market segments.

Business group

The Intel Foundry team is dedicated to developing and enabling advanced semiconductor manufacturing solutions that power Intel's leading-edge technologies. As a part of the LTD CMT Litho Tools organization, this internship provides an opportunity to engage in innovative software development and optimization work that supports Intel's broader mission of delivering world-class products to its customers.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and validate system software across firmware, drivers, operating systems, and middleware layers.
Collaborate on cross-stack software optimization for platforms and technologies.
Contribute to reference platform development for targeted domains and market segments.
Engage in hands-on projects that explore new methodologies and solutions in system software engineering.
Learn and apply technical knowledge while building career-relevant skills in a collaborative environment.
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications

Candidate must be pursuing PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or Mathematics.
Candidate must have demonstrated 1 year programming experience in C/C++, Java or Python.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidate should have worked on a project in fields of Computational geometry, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Numerical optimization, scientific computing.
Flexibility to work a 3-month internship during the Summer of 2027 located in Hillsboro, OR.
3.5 or higher GPA is preferred

We invite you to bring your unique skills and perspective to Intel, where innovation thrives. Join us and contribute to shaping the future of technology while developing your expertise and exploring limitless career possibilities.
